Compare complete states, not names or timestamps. Return sorted changed paths. Irrelevant changes do not require review. Do not modify inputs.
Every result must follow OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json. Output objects have exactly the listed fields. Unknown research results have value=null and sources=[]. Also write report.json as a JSON array of evaluate results for requests.json, using current policy.json and evidence.json when present. Keep prior supported behavior. Use actual local checks. import copy, json
from work import evaluate
cases = [
 ({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'}},'current':{'a':{'hash':'1','kind':'file'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['b']}),
 ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
 ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
 ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}}},{'ignored':['x']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
 ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','name':'same','timestamp':1}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','name':'same','timestamp':2}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']}),
 ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'tree','entries':[1,2]}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'tree','entries':[2,1]}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']})
]
for req, pol, expected in cases:
 before=(copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol)); got=evaluate(req,pol); assert got==expected,(got,expected); assert (req,pol)==before
print('6 evaluate checks passed')

import json
from work import evaluate
requests=json.load(open('requests.json'))
policy=json.load(open('policy.json'))
expected=[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]
actual=json.load(open('report.json'))
assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
schema=json.load(open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json'))
for result in actual:
 assert set(result)=={'needs_review','changed'}
 assert isinstance(result['needs_review'],bool)
 assert isinstance(result['changed'],list) and all(isinstance(x,str) for x in result['changed'])
print('report and schema shape verified')
